description: Associations between human diseases and organisms, including observed microbial abundance changes from HMDAD and manually asserted disease–pathogen links from PathoPhenoDB. The relationship does not assert causation; consult sources to distinguish the contributions.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources contributing to the disease–organism association.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the association was last created or changed.

source_contributions.scope: Literature-curated human disease–microbe associations at any taxonomic rank, limited to mapped diseases and microbes represented in SPOKE. Associations require an abundance-change direction; pairs with conflicting Increase and Decrease evidence are excluded.
source_contributions.description: HMDAD (Human Microbe-Disease Association Database, Cui Lab, Peking University) reports observational, non-causal changes in microbial abundance in disease. Multiple records for a disease–microbe pair are combined, with body sites and publications represented as separate de-duplicated sets; the pairing between individual body sites and publications is not retained.

properties.name: hmdad_evidence
properties.description: Direction of the observed change in microbial abundance in the disease.
properties.notes: Required. Never null on an HMDAD-contributed edge.

properties.name: hmdad_body_sites
properties.description: Body sites where the abundance change was observed, stored as unnormalized source text.
properties.notes: Optional. If no contributing row has a value, the property is null (absent) — never stored as an empty list.

properties.name: hmdad_pubmed_ids
properties.type: list of strings (de-duplicated; bare numeric PMIDs)
properties.description: PubMed articles supporting the HMDAD observations.
properties.notes: Optional. If no contributing row has a value, the property is null (absent) — never stored as an empty list.

source_contributions.scope: Manually asserted disease–pathogen associations to existing Disease and NCBI Taxonomy Organism nodes, with no taxonomic-rank restriction. Automatic-only associations and associations without evidence codes are excluded. Disease–phenotype, treatment and antibiotic-resistance data are outside this contribution.
source_contributions.description: A PathoPhenoDB entry in sources indicates that the organism is manually asserted to be a pathogen in the disease. Qualifying records carry ECO:0000218 (manual assertion), including records that also carry ECO:0000203 (automatic assertion). Evidence codes are not stored as edge properties.
